$comment: The case timeline players build. Baseline entries show from the start; the rest appear when the named challenge is solved. 'replaces' strikes through an earlier entry.

baseline.text: The public livestream goes offline (back at 23:57).
An anonymous message in the staff channel accuses Lucien Moreau, with a screenshot and a door log.
Nadia is found in the projection room. Her phone is on the desk, unlocked.

EV01.text: Nadia tells MOTH her proof goes to the Dean at 08:00. MOTH asks her to meet alone in the projection room at 23:50.

EV02.text: According to the staff channel's door log, wristband L07 (Lucien Moreau) opens the projection room.

EV03.text: Lucien and Salma are in photo booth session S27. The seat counts two people; the camera sees one. Lucien doesn't show up on camera, and Salma lied.

EV04.text: Lucien to Nadia: "I did not change them. Please keep this between us." The screenshot cut this out.
The screenshot of Lucien's message is taken on Nadia's own phone, four minutes after she walked into the projection room.

EV05.text: The controller's own record: badge A14 (Yasmine Mansour) opens the projection room at 23:49 and leaves at 23:55. The staff channel's copy was edited.

EV06.text: Yasmine to Salma: at 23:50 get Lucien into the photo booth and keep him there until 23:55.

EV06.label: 14 Oct
EV06.text: Salma tells Yasmine that Lucien doesn't appear in any of her photos. Ten days later, Yasmine has a use for him.

EV07.text: Yasmine's stage photo is taken at the run-through. It goes online at 23:53, from Salma's phone, while Yasmine is upstairs.

EV08.label: 29 Oct
EV08.text: A duplicate Black Cat AV payment of 2,400 goes to account 0412, Yasmine's own. On 31 October at 19:12 the row is erased from the expense export.
